rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a fair-quality blastocyst and acknowledges loose ICM/TE, but it overstates visible certainty from a single soft-focus image and is somewhat imprecise about stage/zona relative to the provided 3BB grade.
Thoroughly integrates age, very low AMH, low oocyte yield, BMI, unexplained diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, with a sensible discussion of morphology versus ploidy and patient factors; probability estimate may be slightly optimistic but is supported.

Mostly aligned with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF counseling, including caution about morphology and nuanced PGT-A discussion; minor deviations include somewhat speculative protocol suggestions and optimistic framing.
Provides practical transfer advice and future-cycle considerations, including lifestyle modification and protocol review, though some recommendations remain broad rather than highly case-specific.
